note: Structural cost model. Mediation points and enforcement classes are derived from the shared resource matrix and are checkable from an API specification without access to any lab's network. THESE ARE NOT ENGINEER-WEEKS and must never be reported as such.

enforcement_classes.structural: Enforce a naming or namespace invariant at the API boundary. Constant work per call, no access to artefact bodies, no tuning, and no false positives -- the invariant either holds or the call is refused.
enforcement_classes.metadata: Normalise one stat field on write. Constant work per call, no access to artefact bodies. Breaks consumers that read the field for a legitimate purpose.
enforcement_classes.capacity: Bound the store: a fixed manifest of slots, or a windowed listing. Constant work per call, but changes cache semantics, so eviction and collision become the operator's problem.
enforcement_classes.payload: Read or rewrite artefact bodies. Work scales with bytes stored rather than with calls, and the control needs an operating point -- which is where false positives and false negatives enter. This is the class a data-loss-prevention monitor belongs to.
